title: Binance adds Ondo’s tokenized stocks in latest RWA push
summary: Binance listed 10 of Ondo's tokenized stocks, ETFs and commodities on Binance Alpha with UAE regulatory approval, expanding crypto access to real-world assets.

title: Ethereum Foundation starts staking ETH as client diversity concerns persist
summary: Ethereum Foundation’s move to stake its own ETH, using minority clients and distributed infrastructure, throws fresh focus on how Ethereum’s staking landscape is evolving.

title: ‘Bitcoin scarcity is dead’: Crypto executives push back on viral claim
summary: Derivatives don’t mint new Bitcoin, analysts say, pushing back on viral claims that state paper BTC has broken the 21-million cap.

title: Solo Bitcoin miner bags over $200K block reward using rented hashrate
summary: A solo Bitcoin miner hit a rare jackpot of more than $200,000 after validating a block through $75 worth of rented hashrate.

title: Vitalik sells 17K ETH in one month after earmarking $45M for privacy
summary: Arkham data shows the Ethereum co-founder’s attributed wallets fell from about 241,000 ETH to 224,000 ETH this month.

title: Stablecoin stagnation, tariffs a headwind for Bitcoin prices, analysts say
summary: Tariff shocks led to a capital rotation from crypto into precious metals and tokenized commodities, as analysts warn that the thin crypto market liquidity is limiting a wider recovery.

title: Telegram CEO faces Russia probe over allegations of terrorism facilitation
summary: Russian authorities claim the Telegram messenger refused to remove 155,000 channels flagged for illegal content, according to multiple media reports.

title: Hashgraph Group launches Hedera-based tool for EU digital product passports
summary: Hashgraph Group has launched a blockchain-based supply-chain traceability solution ahead of the EU’s Digital Product Passport requirements, some of which take effect beginning in 2027.

title: Bitcoin market enters full capitulation as price dips below $63K
summary: Panic selling by short-term holders, combined with the RSI near record lows, suggests that BTC could be transitioning into a full capitulation regime.

title: Bitcoin ETF sell-off is ‘purification’ of bull case, investor says
summary: Bitcoin ETF investors have recorded sustained outflows this year, but EMJ Capital’s Eric Jackson argues a longer-term institutional buyer base could emerge.
